While holding Martial Focus, you may increase your reach for melee attacks by 5 feet until the end of the current turn (a blanket reach increase to every melee attack, not one action's own range; GM applies it manually).

effects.on: attack rolls against targets within 5 feet of you
effects.evidence: take a -2 penalty to attack rolls against targets within 5 feet of you until the start of your next turn

Choose one melee weapon you wield or your Unarmed Strike. Roll the normal damage of that attack form (its damage dice, the ability modifier it adds and a magic weapon's ordinary bonus; no extra dice) and reduce the triggering attack's damage by the amount rolled; an Unarmed Strike with no damage die reduces it by 1 + the ability modifier (combat/ext/needle.py parry_damage, the fencer's own melee weapon). The retaliatory melee attack, with one Exploit that needs no Advantage or ally, is made by combat/ext/needle.py parry_riposte when the reduction reaches 0.

effects.label: Arm Strike: -2 to weapon attacks and Strength/Dexterity checks
effects.evidence: The target takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls made with a weapon held by the affected limb and to Strength/Dexterity ability checks that rely on that limb.

riders: The GM narrows the -2 to the one affected limb (a target that attacks or checks with another free limb) and rules on a target without a suitable limb (immune); the table applies it to every weapon or Unarmed Strike attack roll the target makes and to its checks to escape a grapple.
A bound hand, natural weapon or limb (a creature holding no weapon): the table grapples it and the GM rules which of its attacks the bound limb stops.

effects.evidence: Reduce the triggering attack's damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus (2d8 at CL 5, 3d8 at CL 11, 4d8 at CL 17).

If this reduces the damage to 0, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker, or you may place Bite on the attacker's weapon until the start of your next turn (the Bite goes on the attacker, who holds the weapon).
